title: 我来自海口
cn: 我在海口出生、长大，目前也主要住在海口。
en: I was born and raised in Haikou, and I live here now.

title: 去其他城市读书和生活
cn: 我大学在长沙读了四年，后来在重庆待过一年，也曾在广东工作。
en: I spent four years at university in Changsha, lived in Chongqing for a year, and worked in Guangdong for a while.

title: 我喜欢自己做软件
cn: 我喜欢把生活中的小问题做成可以自己用的软件，平时会用 AI 辅助开发。
en: I enjoy building small apps that solve everyday problems. I use AI tools to help me develop them.

title: 平时健身
cn: 我平时喜欢健身，也会关注训练和拉伸。
en: I'm into working out and I like learning more about training and stretching.

title: 喜欢学舞
cn: 我喜欢尝试学跳舞，特别是有规律的舞蹈动作和节奏。
en: I like learning dance routines, especially when I can break them down into simple steps.

title: 喜欢喝拿铁
cn: 我喜欢中度烘焙咖啡，平时也会做拿铁。
en: I like medium-roast coffee, and I often make lattes at home.
